rules: decoupling: every MCU / ESP VCC 100 nF pad <= 3 mm path to its pin, same layer, own GND via; pre-route and LOCK before Freerouting; scripted check of the cap-pad-to-pin routed length
crystals: Y + 2 x 22 pF <= 3 mm from XTAL1 / XTAL2, hand-routed on F.Cu, no vias, locked, solid GND under, >= 1 mm from the board edge

silkscreen on F.SilkS next to every off-board connector: servo 'S + -' + function, ESC, logic battery '+ - 1S', 6S sense pin names + 'NO GND', GPS pins, power switch, arm, buzzer, ISP name + pin-1, ESP flash header pin names + '3V3 ONLY', reset-hold names; refdes where they fit

GND: B.Cu mostly solid GND, signals mainly on F.Cu, >= 60 stitching vias (none in the antenna keep-out), no thin GND tracks, nlink SPI over unbroken GND, GND_PWR trunk along the board edge not across the B.Cu pour
servo power: SERVO_5V / GND_PWR >= 1.5 mm wide or poured, no neck-downs, more than one via per layer change
boost path: VBAT_LOGIC_RAW -> Q10 -> J15 -> J6 pin 3 and J6 pin 1 -> +5V >= 1.0 mm (1.34 A peak, E), short; the Pololu module flat on J6 with its cut-off trimmer reachable from above

parts.source: user decision 2026-11-05 (1S cannot feed a buck / LDO to 5 V; 'prefer a boost MODULE on a pin header'; 'add an under-voltage cutoff or at least make the logic-battery monitor mandatory'); devicemart no=15855364 = Pololu #2870 (pololu.com/product/2870: 5 V, 1.7 A typ. max, VIN 2-16 V after a 3 V start, EN pin with an 11-turn pot to VIN = adjustable low-VIN cut-off, off below EN 0.7 V / on above 0.8 V = ~114 % hysteresis, PG open-drain, 12.7 x 15.3 x 6.4 mm, no reverse-voltage protection - read 2026-11-05); params.json configs.vtol.electronics.carrier.model '5 V buck for the logic' (line 1755) is superseded
parts.note: pin order A: the vendor page names the five edge pins VOUT, GND, VIN, EN, PG in this order - check the silkscreen of the bought module before soldering. The module sits FLAT on its supplied straight 1x6 header strip (5 pins used; SEL left open = 5 V output, never bridged to VIN = 6 V). EN and PG are not wired on the carrier: EN keeps the module's own pot (set the cut-off to 3.2 V before the first flight: EN = 0.7 V x Vbat / 3.2 V, e.g. 0.81 V at 3.7 V; restart only above ~3.65 V, A/E); PG unused (firmware does not read it). Height on the header ~2.5 + 6.4 = ~9 mm < 13.4 mm (E). Startup current limited to ~700 mA until 5 V is reached (vendor) - the board's typical 0.27 A load starts fine (E)

The JLC Basic crystal C13738 has CL 9 pF and was NOT used
